items.name: Introducing System One Models and Jev
items.short_description: TypeSafe's launch announcement for System One Models and Jev.
items.what_jev_does_here: The article explains Jev's typed probabilistic decisions, model design, evaluations, and early-access release.
items.quality_notes: Primary launch source; performance statements remain vendor-reported.
items.verification_notes: Published September 15, 2026, by TypeSafe AI.

items.name: TypeSafe AI
items.short_description: Official home for TypeSafe AI, System One Models, and Jev.
items.what_jev_does_here: The site introduces Jev, access paths, decision primitives, and current product information.
items.quality_notes: Primary source for product identity and access.
items.verification_notes: The live site identifies Jev as TypeSafe's first public System One Model.

items.name: TypeSafe System One API Reference
items.short_description: Official HTTP API reference for System One requests and responses.
items.what_jev_does_here: The reference defines Jev request fields, typed questions, answers, errors, and model access.
items.quality_notes: Authoritative API source with request and response details.
items.verification_notes: The live documentation describes the System One endpoint and typed answer shapes.

items.name: System One Adapter for Python
items.short_description: Official adapter for comparing System One decisions with LLM-backed implementations.
items.what_jev_does_here: The adapter provides one decision interface for Jev and supported LLM comparison runs.
items.quality_notes: Official companion project for evaluation and development.
items.verification_notes: The repository states that it is a drop-in TypeSafeClient replacement backed by LLM APIs.

items.name: TypeSafe JavaScript and TypeScript SDK
items.short_description: Official JavaScript and TypeScript client for the TypeSafe API.
items.what_jev_does_here: The SDK sends typed Jev questions and exposes inferred structured answer types.
items.quality_notes: Official repository with examples and tests.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents the @typesafe-ai/sdk package and System One calls.

items.name: TypeSafe Python SDK
items.short_description: Official synchronous and asynchronous Python client for TypeSafe.
items.what_jev_does_here: The SDK calls Jev with state and typed questions and returns structured answers.
items.quality_notes: Official repository with sync and async clients.
items.verification_notes: The repository is maintained under the TypeSafe GitHub organization.

items.name: Jev on Cloudflare Workers AI
items.short_description: Cloudflare Workers AI model documentation for TypeSafe Jev.
items.what_jev_does_here: Workers AI accepts shared state and typed questions for Jev evaluation requests.
items.quality_notes: Cloudflare-maintained model documentation.
items.verification_notes: The official Cloudflare page documents a TypeSafe Jev model integration.

items.name: Jev on Netlify AI Gateway
items.short_description: Netlify AI Gateway access for Jev from Netlify Functions.
items.what_jev_does_here: The gateway routes Jev model requests and supplies gateway credentials to deployed functions.
items.quality_notes: Netlify-maintained documentation and product changelog.
items.verification_notes: Netlify documentation and its Jev changelog identify the supported Jev model IDs.

items.name: Jev on Vercel AI Gateway
items.short_description: Vercel AI Gateway model access for TypeSafe Jev.
items.what_jev_does_here: The gateway runs Jev evaluations through AI SDK's experimental evaluate interface.
items.quality_notes: Vercel-maintained model page and changelog entry.
items.verification_notes: The official model page identifies the typesafe-ai/jev gateway model.

items.name: Pydantic AI TypeSafeModel
items.short_description: Pydantic AI adapter for running Jev inside typed agent workflows.
items.what_jev_does_here: The adapter maps Pydantic output fields into Jev questions and thresholded typed answers.
items.quality_notes: Framework-maintained documentation and release history.
items.verification_notes: Pydantic documents TypeSafeModel and its Jev configuration options.

items.name: TypeSafe Jev on OpenRouter
items.short_description: OpenRouter model listings and API access for TypeSafe Jev.
items.what_jev_does_here: OpenRouter exposes Jev model IDs through its dedicated decisions endpoint.
items.quality_notes: OpenRouter-maintained provider listing.
items.verification_notes: The provider page lists TypeSafe Jev models and current access details.

items.name: fast-jev-compaction
items.short_description: Claude Code plugin and library for Jev-directed transcript compaction.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev scores tool calls and results to keep, truncate, or remove during context compaction.
items.quality_notes: Substantial repository with tests, plugin packaging, and explicit limitations.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents Jev request batching, decision thresholds, and fallback behavior.

items.name: jev-guard
items.short_description: Security hook for coding-agent tools and permission checks.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev scores tool-call risk and screens returned content for prompt injection.
items.quality_notes: Direct security use with documented agent integrations.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents Jev-backed permission and content checks.

items.name: jev-mcp by jkudish
items.short_description: MCP server with Jev tools for verification, screening, ranking, and classification.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev supplies typed judgments for verify, screen, find, rerank, classify, decide, and review tools.
items.quality_notes: Documented multi-tool server with package installation.
items.verification_notes: The repository contains an MCP server, usage examples, and a declared MIT license.

items.name: jev-router
items.short_description: Per-turn model router for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev selects a model tier for each new coding-agent turn.
items.quality_notes: Focused routing tool with native CLI integration.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents Jev decisions for model selection in Claude Code and Codex.

items.name: jevwire
items.short_description: Jev decision layer with an MCP server, library, and Claude Code plugin.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev gates, escalates, or steers coding-agent actions through typed policy decisions.
items.quality_notes: Includes a library, server, plugin, tests, and policy examples.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents Jev-backed policy checks and agent configurations.

items.name: TypeSafe Agent Skills
items.short_description: Official agent skills for building with the TypeSafe System One API.
items.what_jev_does_here: The skills teach agents to formulate Jev state, typed questions, thresholds, and evaluations.
items.quality_notes: Official installable skill package.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents installation for Agent Skills-compatible coding tools.

items.name: typesafe-mcp
items.short_description: Go MCP server and CLI for TypeSafe decisions in agent workflows.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev evaluates Choice, Score, and Noul questions through TypeSafe or OpenRouter.
items.quality_notes: Compiled server with several client setup paths.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop, and alternate OpenRouter access.

items.name: Jev Browser
items.short_description: Headless browser agent and MCP client driven by Jev decisions.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev selects browser actions and reports confidence, progress, and stuck state.
items.quality_notes: Reusable CLI, library, and MCP-oriented browser control.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents iterative Jev action selection over browser state.

items.name: Jev Ultrafast
items.short_description: Browser agent that uses Jev for fast operation and element selection.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev chooses the browser operation and target element while a smaller model handles text.
items.quality_notes: Substantive browser demonstrations with documented limitations.
items.verification_notes: The repository identifies Jev's action and DOM-element selection roles.

items.name: Foreman
items.short_description: Software factory coordinator built around TypeSafe Jev decisions.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev selects and supervises bounded actions across a software production workflow.
items.quality_notes: Documented application with substantive code and workflow design.
items.verification_notes: The repository identifies TypeSafe Jev as its decision model.

items.name: Jev Logs
items.short_description: OpenTelemetry log exporter that classifies and routes records with Jev.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev scores log usefulness and directs records to annotation, archival, or deeper analysis.
items.quality_notes: Concrete observability pipeline with a public repository and site.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents Jev-backed log classification through the Vercel AI SDK.

items.name: Jev Search
items.short_description: Web search application with Jev query analysis, source selection, and reranking.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev interprets queries, selects sources, and scores result relevance.
items.quality_notes: Focused search workflow with a public implementation.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents three distinct Jev decision stages.

items.name: pg-jev
items.short_description: PostgreSQL extension for semantic filtering, ranking, and classification with Jev.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev judges table rows through Noul, Choice, and Score questions called from SQL.
items.quality_notes: Includes SQL functions, batching behavior, tests, and documentation.
items.verification_notes: The repository explains the direct TypeSafe API path and each SQL decision function.

items.name: skillranker
items.short_description: Rust CLI that ranks agent skills against live session context.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev scores candidate skills and supports abstention before an agent selects its next capability.
items.quality_notes: Substantial CLI with feedback, structured output, hooks, and calibration guidance.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents direct Jev calls for skill ranking.

items.name: Stanley
items.short_description: Experimental coding agent for bounded implementation and review workflows.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev routes requests and checks changes, tests, security, performance, and compatibility.
items.quality_notes: Current canonical repository for the project formerly named jev-code.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents Jev-first routing and review stages.

items.name: Tax Document Classifier
items.short_description: Tax-document page classifier built on typed Jev decisions.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev assigns IRS form categories from page text and confidence-aware rules.
items.quality_notes: Includes a reproducible corpus, evaluation output, and application code.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents the classification protocol and its measured dataset.

items.name: jevmlx
items.short_description: Local typed-decision runtime for MLX models on Apple Silicon.
items.what_jev_does_here: The runtime produces batched schema-valid decisions over booleans, enums, and multi-select fields.
items.quality_notes: Active repository with a specific hardware and schema focus.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents a local one-pass Jev-style decision interface.

items.name: Kev
items.short_description: Small trainable Jev-like decision model based on Qwen2.5-0.5B.
items.what_jev_does_here: Kev trains and runs typed decision tasks on local hardware.
items.quality_notes: Public training and inference code with a compact local model target.
items.verification_notes: The repository describes a trainable Jev-like model that runs on a MacBook.

items.name: LocalJev
items.short_description: Local Jev-compatible API server backed by DiffusionGemma.
items.what_jev_does_here: The server translates typed questions into local model classifications and returns Jev-compatible responses.
items.quality_notes: Clear compatibility boundaries, tests, and a repeatable model evaluation.
items.verification_notes: The repository states that its generated probabilities are compatible in shape and mathematically distinct from OpenJev logits.

items.name: NanoJev
items.short_description: Small parallel decision model with a public training pipeline.
items.what_jev_does_here: NanoJev maps state and dynamic candidates to probability distributions without text decoding.
items.quality_notes: Includes a model, dataset pipeline, training code, demos, and benchmarks.
items.verification_notes: The repository explicitly describes an independent nano replica of Jev.

items.name: OpenJev
items.short_description: Open System One server with a Jev-compatible typed decision API.
items.what_jev_does_here: OpenJev returns typed probabilities and confidence from open DiffusionGemma models.
items.quality_notes: Public compatible server with deployment instructions and code.
items.verification_notes: The repository states that it does not call TypeSafe and implements a compatible endpoint.

items.name: SemIf
items.short_description: Independent typed probability system for open models on local hardware.
items.what_jev_does_here: SemIf produces option probabilities from open models without autoregressive decoding.
items.quality_notes: Canonical successor to the author's former openjev repository.
items.verification_notes: The repository clearly disclaims TypeSafe affiliation and documents local implementations.

items.name: Simple Jev
items.short_description: Open classifier server that exposes supported models through typed decision endpoints.
items.what_jev_does_here: The server reads next-token logits and constructs Choice, Score, and truth judgments.
items.quality_notes: Public code, hosted demo, API documentation, and several model backends.
items.verification_notes: The repository distinguishes its approach from TypeSafe's model architecture and training.

items.name: jev-agent-failure-benchmark
items.short_description: Agent-failure evaluation using 6,257 traces from the Who and When Pro dataset.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev predicts structured failure categories for comparison with published LLM baselines.
items.quality_notes: Large pinned dataset with an explicit baseline-comparability warning.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents its dataset, protocol, and results.

items.name: jev-benchmarks
items.short_description: Reproducible classification and calibration evaluation for Jev and GLiNER2.5.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev produces probability distributions for classification, calibration, and abstention analysis.
items.quality_notes: Pinned data, model, seed, hashes, bootstrap analysis, and stated limitations.
items.verification_notes: The repository includes the evaluation protocol and reproducible outputs.

items.name: jev-rerank-bench
items.short_description: Search reranking comparison across Jev and dedicated rerankers.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev scores candidate relevance through typed questions across eight English datasets.
items.quality_notes: Raw responses, scoring code, evidence exports, and confidence intervals.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents 1,617 scored questions and its comparison protocol.

items.name: TypeSafe Workflow Evals
items.short_description: Official workflow evaluations for Jev decision tasks.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev answers typed questions inside security, observability, invoice, and customer-service workflows.
items.quality_notes: Primary vendor evaluation surface with stated workloads.
items.verification_notes: The site publishes TypeSafe-run workflow results; readers must treat them as vendor-reported.

items.name: Jev for Engineers
items.short_description: Minimal Jev examples for mechanical and electrical engineering scenarios.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev supplies Choice, Score, and Noul judgments for eight engineering examples.
items.quality_notes: Standalone scripts, comments, and offline tests.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents each engineering scenario and its Jev question type.

items.name: TypeSafe Documentation and Cookbooks
items.short_description: Official quickstarts, primitive guides, patterns, and Jev cookbooks.
items.what_jev_does_here: The documentation demonstrates typed decisions, batching, routing, scoring, confidence, and agent integration.
items.quality_notes: Authoritative learning material with runnable examples.
items.verification_notes: The live documentation includes quickstarts, patterns, primitives, and cookbooks.

items.name: TypeSafe Jev Examples
items.short_description: Worked Jev examples for ticket triage and reranking.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev applies typed questions to support classification and search-result reranking.
items.quality_notes: Runnable examples with fixtures, provider selection, and offline tests.
items.verification_notes: The repository documents direct and OpenRouter paths with the same typed protocol.

items.name: TypeSafe Playground
items.short_description: Interactive playground for Jev patterns, workflows, agents, games, and code review.
items.what_jev_does_here: Jev drives typed decisions across a collection of interactive experiments.
items.quality_notes: Runnable catalog with clear mock and live labels.
items.verification_notes: The repository states that it is a community project and documents its Jev labs.

items.name: Awesome Jev by TypeSafe
items.short_description: Source-linked community directory for Jev projects, integrations, and articles.
items.what_jev_does_here: The directory groups projects using Jev for decisions, routing, ranking, verification, and guardrails.
items.quality_notes: Source links and vendor-claim caveats distinguish it from generated directories.
items.verification_notes: The repository disclaims TypeSafe affiliation and links its listed resources.

items.name: Jevify
items.short_description: Agent skill for identifying Jev opportunities and planning decision experiments.
items.what_jev_does_here: The skill guides agents through Choice, Score, Noul, threshold, and evaluation design.
items.quality_notes: Includes an installable skill, evaluation references, and planning scripts.
items.verification_notes: The repository identifies itself as independent guidance and keeps API claims sourced.

items.name: Learn Jev Tutorials
items.short_description: Independent tutorials for Jev concepts, patterns, confidence, and reliability.
items.what_jev_does_here: The tutorials teach typed decision design with cURL, Python, and TypeScript examples.
items.quality_notes: Independent learning site that links to primary TypeSafe material.
items.verification_notes: The site labels itself unaffiliated with TypeSafe AI and publishes Jev-specific tutorials.
